title: SHREE MANSHANTI CHATRALAY, SHIRUR
heroText: Its home to destitute and needy children Established in 2017 at Shirur (Ghodnadi), Pune, CEO: Mr. Vinay Sapkal, adopted son of Mai, Current Beneficiaries : 80
points: To provide the basic necessities of food, shelter, cloth and medical care and education to children.
The organisation motivates and supports its children to get educated and learn vocational skills.
